lineage.description: OpenStreetMap road network data from November 2014 was attributed with road surface material and quality classifications derived from UK Ministry of Defence JIATF Geo Cell data. The resulting dataset provides a spatial inventory of transportation infrastructure in Sierra Leone classified by surface type, supporting disaster risk and humanitarian logistics analysis.
